youtube.title: OKX Promo Code: What New Users Can Enter
youtube.description:
For new users, the OKX promo code you enter at sign-up is a referral code. There's no separate coupon box; promotions are listed in the app's rewards page with their own terms.

Referral code: XOACPQFC

Skip any promo that asks for a deposit, your login, or comes from an unknown site.

Updated: November 2026

Educational content only. Not financial advice. Independent channel, not affiliated with OKX; this channel may earn a referral commission if you use the code. Check that OKX is available in your country before signing up. The narration voice is AI-generated.
